results.remarks: At 6734 Zumirez, the most valuable investment has already been made: time. Nearly a decade in the making, the vision for this new residence has advanced through architecture, engineering, environmental studies, California Coastal Commission approvals (CDP Permit No. 20-068), city planning, and countless refinements - transforming years of complexity, uncertainty, and investment into a singular opportunity. The project is in the final approval stage with the City of Malibu building department and construction is tentatively scheduled to begin in the fall. While that work quietly unfolded, the property remained exactly what Point Dume has always been: an authentic coastal retreat that you can enjoy from day one. Before the building begins and the architecture evolves, the property is already a place to live, gather, and experience everything that has made Point Dume one of Malibu's most treasured enclaves. The beautifully restored 1949 cottage offers two bedrooms, one bath, and expansive ocean views from nearly every room. Filled with natural light and opening to generous decks overlooking the Pacific, it captures the quiet simplicity that first defined coastal Malibu. The existing home is warm, inviting, and effortlessly livable - a place to spend weekends by the beach, gather family and friends, and embrace the slower rhythm that has defined this stretch of coastline for generations. Enjoy it exactly as it exists today or begin creating the future estate when the time is right. The difficult part...the years spent navigating approvals, revisions, and entitlements has already been accomplished. The architecture can be built. The investment can be made. But the years required to arrive here cannot be bought. The CDP approved new residence consists of approximately 7,303 square feet, an additional 986 square foot basement, 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, 50 foot oceanside pool and jacuzzi, movie theatre, spa facilities with massage room, cold plunge, dry sauna and steam shower; a separate guest retreat with an additional bedroom and bathroom, private jacuzzi and tranquil garden space. Warm and natural materials are planned for the construction with every wall, every proportion, every transition, and every framed view thoughtfully refined. Nothing was incidental. Every decision served a singular purpose: to create a residence whose architecture feels as relevant decades from now as it does today. Every decision was ultimately guided by one simple belief: Architecture should not compete with nature. It should reveal it. While many Malibu homes are designed to admire the ocean from afar, the new residence is designed to live with it, where the coastline becomes an extension of home. A private pathway leads directly from the property to the sand, allowing you to leave home and arrive at the beach in moments...this way of living becomes a natural extension of your everyday routine. Included with the property is also ownership in the highly coveted Malibu Riviera One, a private beachfront parcel owned collectively by Zumirez homeowners. Beyond its privacy and exclusivity, it transforms a day at the beach into an effortless experience, being the only gate in Point Dume with drive-up access, parking just steps from the sand. The true luxury isn't simply private ownership, it's removing the effort between home and the ocean. Together, the private pathway directly from the home itself and ownership of Malibu Riviera One create an experience found on only a select handful of Point Dume properties.

Miles of nearby hiking trails wind through breathtaking canyons with ocean vistas and peaceful creek beds just beyond your backyard. Offering sweeping ocean views, usable acreage, incredible versatility, and an authentic connection to Malibu's rich ranching heritage, this is far more than a home it's a private sanctuary where history, nature, and opportunity come together. results.remarks: A soulful Corral Canyon retreat with sweeping mountain views, flexible living spaces, and a separate-entry guest suite just minutes from PCH. Set among mature oaks and canyon greenery, this four-bedroom Malibu home offers volume, light, privacy, and an indoor-outdoor rhythm that captures the relaxed beauty of canyon living with easy access to Malibu's coastline. Nestled on a generous lot amidst nature, this property is the perfect reflection of the quiet serenity and tight-knit charm that defines this special Malibu neighborhood. The home welcomes you through a charming garden entry courtyard. The interior features soaring ceilings and architectural elements such as wood beams, large windows and reclaimed wood flooring throughout. This four-bedroom residence offers a comfortable layout with spaces that flow naturally towards the outdoors. The primary suite, along with the open living room, dining room, half-bath, spacious chef's kitchen and large porch, are on the main level, while the downstairs consists of an open family room flanked by two additional bedrooms. The fourth bedroom has a separate entrance and functions as an attached guest suite complete with it's own kitchen, laundry, outdoor shower, hot tub, and a tranquil sitting area. Ideally positioned just eight minutes from PCH, the home places you at the doorstep of everything that makes Malibu one of the most coveted communities in the world. Malibu's brand new, highly regarded schools are close by, while some of the coast's most spectacular hiking trails wind through the surrounding Santa Monica Mountains with sweeping ocean panoramas at nearly every turn. World-famous beaches, beloved local dining, and the laid-back energy of Malibu's coastline are all just a short drive down the canyon. Outdoor living is woven throughout the property with multiple decks and screened living spaces that frame the canyon scenery from every angle, perfect for morning coffee as the light fills the valley, sunset dinners as the sky shifts to gold, or simply sitting in stillness surrounded by birdsong and oak-scented air. This is a home where nature is not a backdrop, but a daily companion, and where the seamless connection between indoors and out is felt in every moment.

Terraced grounds cascade gently down the hillside, creating intimate settings for morning espresso, late afternoon wine, or evenings under the stars.

It’s romantic, but not delicate—grounded, soulful, and deeply authentic.

Whether as a full-time residence or a canyon getaway, it lives like a permanent vacation—where every day feels just a little more elevated, a little more intentional.

This is not just a home.
It’s a feeling.

results.remarks: Believed to be  Malibu's oldest standing residence, this extraordinary 1922 stone cabin offers a rare connection to the earliest days of the Malibu canyons. Originally built as a hunting retreat, the property dates to an era when travelers rode horseback from Los Angeles into the wilds of Malibu, staying here amid abundant wildlife and the life-giving waters of a year-round creek. Perched above the flowing creek and surrounded by the timeless beauty of the canyon, the home feels inseparable from its natural settingan enduring sanctuary shaped by stone, water, and more than a century of history. More than a residence, this is a living piece of Malibu's past and an exceptionally rare opportunity to preserve and inhabit its story. The property is over an acre with its own hiking trail leading up to a sitting area with ocean views through the mountains. Also on the property are two guests house both with living rooms, bathrooms and bedrooms allowing you to keep the charm of the cabin while allowing you space for guests on the property.
